UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.description: A Secret Canal: With Nazi Germany's rise to power, a long-abandoned canal project in East Prussia is resurrected, but the true purpose of this massive waterway comes into question. S4 Ep1

UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.title: Antiques Roadshow
UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.description: Lulworth Castle 1: Fiona Bruce and the team visit Lulworth Castle in Dorset, where items include a rare copy of the abdication papers of Edward VIII. S34 Ep3

UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.title: Dom Chinea's Cornish Workshop
UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.description: Dom builds a drift car with engineer Sam Lovegrove. At home, he gets a digger in to make his new pond, and he and Sam have a go at gig rowing after fixing the club trailer in Hayle. S1 Ep3

UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.title: Train Truckers
UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.description: Class 37: The Train Truckers are on the clock this week as they attempt to move a 100-ton diesel engine to a gala extravaganza, as well as a 175-ton rail crane destined for Egypt. S2 Ep8

UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.title: Tropic of Cancer with Simon Reeve
UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.description: India: Simon Reeve continues his epic journey around the world. In India, he travels from the coast of Gujarat to Kolkata in the east, via Bhopal and Gandhi's home town of Ahmedabad. S1 Ep4

UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.title: Bangers & Cash
UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.description: Lotus Esprit/MG TF/ERF Lorry: On the way to pick up two lovely '70s Lotus sports cars, Derek takes to the skies for his first ever helicopter flight in a 1967 Bell 47 chopper. S9 Ep10
